description: Royal Guard Saber (왕도 근위검): a fine curved sabre of bright steel with a gilded basket guard and a crimson-wrapped grip, the blade catching a gleam (tier III, elite).
Archive Longbow (기록원 장궁): a tall elegant longbow of dark polished wood with brass tips and slim leather wraps, a pale ribbon bound near the grip (tier III, elite).
Ward Rod (결계 지팡이): a slender rod of pale silver-grey wood capped with a small clear crystal that holds a faint swirl of lavender mist (tier III, elite).
Court Vestment (궁정 사제복): a folded court priest vestment of ivory silk with a deep plum stole and fine silver edging, laid neatly (tier III, elite).
Grey Mantle (회색 외투): a long ash-grey hooded mantle folded over itself, soft wool with a plain dark clasp (tier III, elite).
Oath Ring (맹세의 반지): a heavy plain gold band with a smooth dark-blue stone set flush, a faint warm glow around it (tier III, elite).
Archivist's Lens (기록관의 확대경): a round brass reading lens on a short wooden handle lying on a page of blank parchment, the glass catching a bright glint.
Lantern of Echoes (잔영의 등불): a small old brass lantern with frosted glass panes, pale silver-lavender mist and a soft steady light curling inside it.
